    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.06, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Thus, the efficiency of devices increases from 22.41% to 25.06% after 2-HPMA modification."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,

    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "2-HPMA modification raises the device PCE from 22.41% to 25.06%.", "anchor": "Thus, the efficiency of devices increases from 22.41% to 25.06% after 2-HPMA modification.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices retain 88% of original PCE after 1000 h storage in ambient air.", "anchor": "The unencapsulated device can retain 88% of its original PCE after storage in ambient air for 1000 h, and 86% of its pristine PCE after aging for 100 h at 60%‒80% relative humidity (RH) conditions.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Polymer-lead interactions largely inhibit lead leakage from unencapsulated PSCs.", "anchor": "Furthermore, the interaction between the polymers and lead can largely inhibit lead leakage from unencapsulated PSCs.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 1,
    "architecture": "unknown",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.0, "unit": "%", "anchor": "This AI-designed recipe effectively achieves a champion PCE value of over 26.0 %, approaching world records achieved through extensive expert trial-and-error."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "PVK-LLM domain knowledge is integrated into a hierarchical Bayesian Optimization workflow on a solar cell simulator platform.", "anchor": "By integrating this domain knowledge into a hierarchical Bayesian Optimization workflow, our approach efficiently navigates the high-dimension design space on a solar cell simulator platform.", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "The framework autonomously proposes a novel four-component passivation recipe (3MTPAI, PDAI2, EDAI2, and PipDI) not previously reported.", "anchor": "our framework autonomously proposes a novel synergistic four-component recipe comprising specialized organic passivation recipe (3MTPAI, PDAI2, EDAI2, and PipDI) which has not been reported in existing literature.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The AI-designed recipe achieves a champion PCE over 26.0% in wet-lab experiments.", "anchor": "This AI-designed recipe effectively achieves a champion PCE value of over 26.0 %, approaching world records achieved through extensive expert trial-and-error.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 2,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": "Cs2AgBiBr6",
    "pce_champion": null,
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Screening of 25 ETL-HTL combinations identifies CeO2 and P3HT as optimal transport layers.", "anchor": "Screening of 25 electron transport layer (ETL)-hole transport layer (HTL) combinations identifies CeO2 and P3HT as the optimal ETL and HTL respectively.", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "The simulated optimized device reaches a theoretical upper-bound PCE of 31.76%.", "anchor": "Under optimized parameters, the simulated device achieves a PCE of 31.76%, representing the theoretical upper bound predicted by the model.", "evidence_type": "simulation"},
      {"text": "This is claimed to be the first comprehensive 3D FEM-based study of a double halide perovskite solar cell.", "anchor": "To our knowledge, this work represents the first comprehensive 3D FEM-based study of a double halide perovskite solar cell.", "evidence_type": "inference"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 3,
    "architecture": "tandem_2T",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 31.43, "unit": "%", "anchor": "As a result, single‐junction perovskite solar cells deliver a PCE of 22.23%, while monolithic perovskite/TOPCon tandems achieve 31.43%, both with markedly improved ISOS‐L‐1 and ISOS‐L‐2 stability."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-1, ISOS-L-2",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "OFNA is introduced as a volatile multifunctional additive in the perovskite.", "anchor": "To address this issue, we introduce octafluoronaphthalene (OFNA) as a volatile multifunctional additive.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "OFNA regulates crystallization, passivates defects, and relieves residual tensile stress.", "anchor": "Benefiting from synergistic anion–π and hydrogen‐bond interactions, OFNA regulates crystallization kinetics, passivates defects, and relieves residual tensile stress, yielding high‐quality perovskite films with enhanced photothermal stability.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Single-junction cells reach 22.23% and monolithic perovskite/TOPCon tandems reach 31.43% PCE.", "anchor": "As a result, single‐junction perovskite solar cells deliver a PCE of 22.23%, while monolithic perovskite/TOPCon tandems achieve 31.43%, both with markedly improved ISOS‐L‐1 and ISOS‐L‐2 stability.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 4,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.1, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Consequently, the optimized n‐i‐p PSCs incorporating this RP interlayer achieve a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.10% with notably reduced hysteresis."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-D-1, ISOS-L-1I, ISOS-T-1",
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "The RP interlayer achieves a champion PCE of 26.10% with reduced hysteresis.", "anchor": "Consequently, the optimized n‐i‐p PSCs incorporating this RP interlayer achieve a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.10% with notably reduced hysteresis.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Unencapsulated devices retain 91.6% of initial efficiency after 1320 h at 65 ± 10% RH (ISOS-D-1).", "anchor": "The suppression ion migration promotes the stability of unencapsulated RP‐assisted devices, enabling them to retain 91.6% of their initial efficiency after 1320 h storage at 65 ± 10% RH (ISOS‐D‐1).", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Devices maintain 90% efficiency after 1200 h MPP tracking (ISOS-L-1I) and 88.8% after 240 h at 85°C (ISOS-T-1).", "anchor": "These devices exhibit excellent illumination and thermal stability, maintaining 90% of their initial efficiency after 1200 h of MPP tracking under illumination (ISOS‐L‐1I) and 88.8% after 240 h of thermal aging at 85°C (ISOS‐T‐1).", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 5,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.27, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Consequently, the champion device delivers an efficiency of 25.27% with an ultralow voltage loss of 0.356 V and retains 80% of its initial efficiency after over 1300 h of continuous 1‐sun operation."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": {"value": 1300, "unit": "h", "anchor": "and retains 80% of its initial efficiency after over 1300 h of continuous 1‐sun operation"},
    "claims": [
      {"text": "4-TB and Me-4PACz form a synergistic SAM that suppresses aggregation and improves hole extraction.", "anchor": "The strong intermolecular π–π stacking between 4‐TB and Me‐4PACz suppresses aggregation, enhances surface uniformity, and increases the interfacial dipole, thereby improving hole extraction.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The champion inverted device reaches 25.27% efficiency with a voltage loss of 0.356 V.", "anchor": "Consequently, the champion device delivers an efficiency of 25.27% with an ultralow voltage loss of 0.356 V and retains 80% of its initial efficiency after over 1300 h of continuous 1‐sun operation.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "A 1.82 eV wide-bandgap PSC achieves 19.44% efficiency with VOC of 1.33 V.", "anchor": "A 1.82 eV wide‐bandgap PSC also achieves an efficiency of 19.44% with a high V OC of 1.33 V, demonstrating the broad applicability of this synergistic molecular‐engineering strategy.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 6,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 26.2, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Consequently, this versatile ATO nanocrystal platform delivers impressive efficiencies: a champion (average) power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.2% (25.2 ± 0.46%) in n‐i‐p PSCs"},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A nonaqueous platform of Sb-doped SnO2 nanocrystals enables ETLs for both n-i-p and p-i-n configurations.", "anchor": "Herein, a stable, nonaqueous platform of conductive Sb‐doped SnO 2 (ATO) nanocrystals (∼4 nm) is developed, enabling high‐performance ETLs for both device configurations.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The ATO platform delivers 26.2% champion PCE in n-i-p and 21.2% in p-i-n PSCs without a buffer layer.", "anchor": "a champion (average) power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 26.2% (25.2 ± 0.46%) in n‐i‐p PSCs and, notably, 21.2% (20.4 ± 0.42%) in p‐i‐n PSCs without any buffer layer—the highest for a solution‐processed, sole SnO 2 ‐based ETL in this challenging architecture.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The nanocrystals are near-monodispersed and stable in low-polarity solvents for over one year.", "anchor": "This platform is built upon a tert ‐butanol‐based synthesis, yielding nanocrystals that are near‐monodispersed and stable in low‐polarity solvents for over one year, addressing the fundamental processing incompatibility.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 7,
    "architecture": "module",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 19.89, "unit": "%", "anchor": "and the resulting perovskite‐organic tandem module achieves a PCE of 19.89% at 16.41 cm 2 active area, demonstrating a robust pathway for high‐performance scalable photovoltaics."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": {"value": 16.41, "unit": "cm2", "anchor": "the resulting perovskite‐organic tandem module achieves a PCE of 19.89% at 16.41 cm 2 active area"},
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Nicotinic hydrazide treatment eliminates aggregated 2PACz, yielding an aggregate-free SAM layer.", "anchor": "We demonstrate that NH effectively eliminates the aggregated 2PACz by forming an energetically favorable complex with the phosphonic acid groups, yielding an uniform and aggregate‐free SAM layer.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "OPV devices reach 15.38% efficiency with a blade-coated 1 cm2 active area.", "anchor": "Integrating this optimized SAM into OPV devices leads to significantly improved efficiency of 15.38% using a blade‐coated 1 cm 2 active area, primarily due to improved charge extraction and reduced trap‐assisted recombination, which enhance both open‐circuit voltage and fill factor.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "OPV module PCE improves from 14.07% to 15.02%.", "anchor": "As a result, the power conversion efficiency (PCE) of OPV modules are enhanced from 14.07% to 15.02%, and the resulting perovskite‐organic tandem module achieves a PCE of 19.89% at 16.41 cm 2 active area, demonstrating a robust pathway for high‐performance scalable photovoltaics.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 8,
    "architecture": "module",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": null,
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "A 5 × 5 perovskite auxetic platform reaches a ~900 cm2 footprint and preserves I–V characteristics over repeated deformation cycles.", "anchor": "A 5 × 5 perovskite platform reaches a decimeter‐scale footprint (∼900 cm 2 ), conformally deploys on dome‐like surfaces, and preserves photovoltaic I – V characteristics over repeated expansion–contraction cycles.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Selectively activatable AgNW–GO–EGaIn composite interconnects provide mechanically or laser-rupture-activated conduction.", "anchor": "To wire the mechanically active joints, we develop selectively activatable AgNW–GO–EGaIn composite interconnects that combine partially embedded Ag nanowires for adhesion with graphene oxide–coated EGaIn liquid‐metal particles (GO@EGaIn LMPs) for mechanically or laser‐rupture‐activated conduction.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The interconnects maintain conductivity under folding and large tensile deformation.", "anchor": "The interconnects enable on‐demand patterning and maintain conductivity under folding and large tensile deformation.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 9,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25, "unit": "%", "anchor": "As a result, the modified devices achieved a significant boost in PCE from 23% to over 25%, along with improved V oc and J sc."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Two UV absorbers, 7-Amino-4-methylcoumarin and 7-Hydroxy-4-methylcoumarin, are introduced into the Me-4PACz solution.", "anchor": "Addressing this challenge, two ultraviolet absorbers, 7‐Amino‐4‐methylcoumarin and 7‐Hydroxy‐4‐methylcoumarin as multifunctional additives were introduced into the Me‐4PACZ solution, and can not only effectively filter harmful UV radiation, preserving the structural integrity of SAMs, but also enhance the uniformity and compactness of the monolayer and passivate defects at the perovskite buried interface by coordinating with uncoordinated lead ions.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Modified devices boost PCE from 23% to over 25% with improved VOC and JSC.", "anchor": "As a result, the modified devices achieved a significant boost in PCE from 23% to over 25%, along with improved V oc and J sc.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Device photostability is substantially enhanced under continuous illumination.", "anchor": "Furthermore, the photostability of the devices was substantially enhanced under continuous illumination.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 10,
    "architecture": "n-i-p",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.81, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Consequently, optimized co‐deposition devices achieved a champion power conversion efficiency of 25.81% with a T 80 lifetime exceeding 4000 h under ISOS‐L‐1I protocol."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": "ISOS-L-1I",
    "t80_h": {"value": 4000, "unit": "h", "anchor": "optimized co‐deposition devices achieved a champion power conversion efficiency of 25.81% with a T 80 lifetime exceeding 4000 h under ISOS‐L‐1I protocol"},
    "claims": [
      {"text": "Co-deposition and pre-deposition of the ADA SAM give identical distribution and comparable passivation at the buried interface.", "anchor": "Our results reveal identical SAM distribution/orientation and comparable defect passivation efficacy at the buried interface for both strategies.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Co-deposition modulates crystal growth kinetics, enlarging grains and suppressing bulk defects.", "anchor": "Crucially, co‐deposition facilitates extensive interactions between SAMs and perovskite precursors during crystallization, significantly modulating crystal growth kinetics with enlarged grains and suppressed bulk defects.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "Co-deposition devices reach 25.81% champion PCE with T80 over 4000 h under ISOS-L-1I.", "anchor": "Consequently, optimized co‐deposition devices achieved a champion power conversion efficiency of 25.81% with a T 80 lifetime exceeding 4000 h under ISOS‐L‐1I protocol.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  },
  {
    "i": 11,
    "architecture": "p-i-n",
    "absorber": null,
    "pce_champion": {"value": 25.31, "unit": "%", "anchor": "Consequently, inverted PSCs incorporating TBA achieve a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.31%, accompanied by an enhanced open‐circuit voltage and negligible J–V hysteresis."},
    "pce_certified": null,
    "pce_stabilised": null,
    "active_area_cm2": null,
    "stability_protocol": null,
    "t80_h": null,
    "claims": [
      {"text": "TBA coordinates with undercoordinated Pb2+ and hydrogen-bonds with FA+ for site-selective anchoring at the perovskite surface.", "anchor": "Benefiting from its dual hydroxyl and thiol functionalities, TBA establishes strong multidentate coordination with undercoordinated Pb 2+ ions while simultaneously forming robust hydrogen bonds with formamidinium (FA + ) cations, enabling site‐selective anchoring at the perovskite surface.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "The cooperative interaction reduces trap density, suppresses nonradiative recombination, and optimizes energy-level alignment.", "anchor": "This cooperative coordination–hydrogen‐bonding interaction effectively reduces interfacial trap density, suppresses nonradiative recombination, and optimizes energy‐level alignment at the perovskite/ETL interface.", "evidence_type": "measurement"},
      {"text": "TBA-based inverted PSCs reach a champion PCE of 25.31% with negligible J–V hysteresis.", "anchor": "Consequently, inverted PSCs incorporating TBA achieve a champion power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.31%, accompanied by an enhanced open‐circuit voltage and negligible J–V hysteresis.", "evidence_type": "measurement"}
    ]
  }
]
